info.title: uiguide 0.6.0 - UiGuide Agent developer tool
info.description: UiGuide Agent developer tool: init, scan, bundle, doctor.

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Generate uiguide.bundle.json from the code (+ what you wrote in uiguide.map.json)

options.name: --check
options.description: Do not write: exit code 1 when uiguide.bundle.json is not up to date (CI)

options.name: --language
options.description: Language of the texts without a language in their file name (default: uiguide.json, else en)

options.name: --app-version
options.description: Application version in the bundle (default: <Version> of the project, else 1.0.0)

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the setup: project, package, uiguide.json, server, LLM, knowledge bundle, names, WebView2

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show this help, or the help of a command: uiguide help <command>

commands.name: init
commands.description: Connect your application project to the UiGuide Agent server (writes uiguide.json)

options.name: --server
options.description: UiGuide Agent server (default http://localhost:5180)

options.name: --app-id
options.description: Application id: lowercase letters, digits, '-' (default: from the project name)

options.name: --language
options.description: Language of the assistant, e.g. de-DE (default: the application's UI culture)

options.name: --description
options.description: One sentence about what the application does (for the server profile)

options.name: --origins
options.description: Web: the pages allowed to use the server, comma separated (default: from the project — MAUI Blazor https://0.0.0.1, launchSettings.json, dev servers)

options.name: --no-register
options.description: Do not register the application on the local server

options.name: --yes
options.description: Ask nothing, use the defaults

commands.name: key
commands.description: Create an application key (server auth "AppKey") for using the server from the network

options.name: --app-id
options.description: Application id (default: from the project's uiguide.json)

options.name: --server
options.description: UiGuide Agent server (default: from the project's uiguide.json)

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Do not write the key into uiguide.json (only print it)

commands.name: record
commands.description: Record a task done once in your application as a flow (uiguide.map.json)

options.name: --goal
options.description: What the user wants to do, in their words (e.g. "export the orders")

options.name: --run
options.description: Command line that starts the application (default: the built .exe; Python: python <main>.py)

options.name: --from
options.description: Use an existing recording file instead of starting the application

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only show the steps, do not change uiguide.map.json

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Take UiGuide Agent out of the project (package, generated files, script line, registration)

options.name: --all
options.description: Also delete uiguide.map.json and uiguide.tests.json

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove even when code still calls the SDK (you fix the build)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only show what would be removed

commands.name: scan
commands.description: List the controls without an accessible name (XAML, WinForms, C# code) — name each one after what it does

options.name: --fix
options.description: Copy your own tooltip / hint / inner text into AutomationProperties.Name (XAML, designer; edits the files)

options.name: --all
options.description: List the named controls too

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: Build format: one 'warning UIG001' line per control without a name (file(line): …)

options.name: --errors
options.description: With --msbuild: report them as errors instead of warnings

commands.name: setup
commands.description: What the build does by itself: uiguide.json, the local server if it runs, the copy for your users

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: Build format: 'warning UIG003' lines

options.name: --for-users
options.description: Write the uiguide.json that goes next to the executable to this file

options.name: --web-config
options.description: Write the configuration the web page reads (uiguide.config.json) to this file

options.name: --release
options.description: This build goes to your users: no address of this computer in the files above

options.name: --allow-local
options.description: Keep an address of this computer even with --release

options.name: --required
options.description: With --release: no address for your users is an error, not a warning

options.name: --timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the server on this computer, in milliseconds (default 1000)

options.name: --no-texts
options.description: Do not ask the server for the assistant panel's texts in the application's languages

options.name: --texts-timeout
options.description: How long to wait for those texts, in milliseconds (default 90000; only while some are missing)

commands.name: test
commands.description: Ask the benchmark questions (uiguide.tests.json) and check the answers

options.name: --file
options.description: Benchmark file (default uiguide.tests.json in the project)

options.name: --server
options.description: Another server than the one in uiguide.json (e.g. a test server)

options.name: --filter
options.description: Only questions containing this text

options.name: --repeat
options.description: Ask each question this many times; all must pass (stability, default 1)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds per answer (default 180)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Bring the project to the latest UiGuide Agent (NuGet / npm package)

options.name: --check
options.description: Only say whether a newer release exists

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: With --check: as the build warning UIG002 (one line)
